rows.en: ＊Amane＊＠０２７＿０１０Oh... are you okay?
＊Amane＊＠０２７＿０１１Is it okay for you to be up?￥I heard you collapsed, and I￥got so scared I rushed over.
＊Amane＊＠０２７＿０１２You shouldn't train so hard you￥collapse!
＊Amane＊＠０２７＿０１３If you're not healthy, you￥can't do anything, even if you￥make it to Elan!
You're totally right.
I know that already!
You're totally right.
I know that already!
＊Amane＊＠０２７＿０１４Don't act like it's not about￥you! I'm talking about YOU!
＊Amane＊＠０２７＿０１５Do you really get it?￥Geez!!
＊Amane＊＠０２７＿０１６Don't talk like that!￥I'm saying this 'cause I'm￥worried about you!
＊Amane＊＠０２７＿０１７I think you should listen when￥people tell you stuff.
＊Amane＊＠０２７＿０１８Being a candidate means a lot￥of pressure and plenty of tough￥stuff, but...
＊Amane＊＠０２７＿０１９Still, we're a team, right?￥At least, that's how I see it!
I feel the same way.
Aren't we rivals?
I feel the same way.
Aren't we rivals?
＊Amane＊＠０２７＿０２０Thanks!
＊Amane＊＠０２７＿０２１I'm worried about you.￥Take better care of yourself!
＊Amane＊＠０２７＿０２２I guess you could say that,￥but I'd rather think of us as￥teammates... no, as friends!
＊Amane＊＠０２７＿０２３Maybe everybody else secretly￥feels the same way, you know?
＊Amane＊＠０２７＿０２４Getting to Elan is important,￥but doing your best with what￥you can do right here, now...
＊Amane＊＠０２７＿０２５I think that's just as￥important as getting to Elan.
＊Amane＊＠０２７＿０２６I get that you're anxious. But￥let's take it slow, one thing￥at a time!
＊Amane＊＠０２７＿０２７If there's anything I can do,￥I'll do it, no matter what!
＊Amane＊＠０２７＿０２８Okay, I'm heading back,￥but really, take care!
＊Amane＊＠０２７＿０２９When you're feeling better,￥let's train together!!
＊Amane＊＠０２７＿０３０See ya!!
